Looping in a short triage summary pre-bridge so we have context.

What we saw:
- 07:48–08:20 ET: token pipeline p95 latency rose to ~980ms for ~32 minutes; upstream retrying caused a 3x burst.
- Automated fallback to lighter quantized model did kick in at ~08:02 ET for a subset of requests; routing policy limited impact to non-critical traffic.

Preliminary hypothesis: a routing table flapping event coupled with a regional GPU host IO contention during a background maintenance window. We have an infra ticket (SUP-7231) open and have filed metrics and cache dumps.

Immediate mitigations applied:
- Increased routing hold time to avoid rapid churn (temporary)
- Bumped burst capacity for the Dedicated pool serving Aurelius by 20% for next 24h
- Disabled a non-critical background compaction job in region-us-east-1 for the morning window

I will finalize a 1-page triage doc and attach to the bridge notes before 11:00 ET.

Rishi Malhotra
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
